summary_en: The 2026 Silk Road Civilization Development Forum was held in Fuzhou, Fujian on November 4, attended by representatives from Chinese and foreign media, government departments, research institutions and business circles. Jiang Bo, a professor at Wuhan University, used underwater archaeological discoveries such as the "Nanhai No.1" to outline the exchange of civilizations along the Maritime Silk Road; Xu Tao, director of the Central Asia Research Office of the Development Research Center of the State Council, pointed out that more than 2,000 years of Silk Road connectivity has accumulated valuable experience.
